output: html_document

## 1. Purpose

This stage loads the raw CPC18 and choices13k datasets into R without modifying the original source files.

The datasets are loaded as in-memory working objects, and their column names are standardized for subsequent analysis.

## 2. Load Required Packages

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "..")

library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(janitor)
```

## 3. Load Datasets

```{r data-loading, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("R/01_data_loading.R")
```

## 4. Loading Confirmation

The pipeline successfully loaded both raw datasets into memory.

- **CPC18:** 694,500 rows × 30 columns
- **choices13k:** 14,568 rows × 16 columns

#### The raw source files are not modified. Data profiling and quality assessment are performed separately in Stage 02.
